fix_subject: Fix internal issue around alter table add column that did not exist
pr_title: I've been working on a fuzzer based on the PEG grammar to iron out more

labels.summary: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with a nested field path whose parent column does not exist raised an internal error instead of a proper catalog error, because the lookup did not validate the parent column; the fix looks it up without the IF NOT EXISTS shortcut so the error is correctly reported.
